homeTitle: Spot the pattern. Find the set.
homeSubtitle: Look across three attributes, find groups of three, and clear each round.
singlePlayerDescription: Practice at your own pace across three rounds.
multiplayerDescription: Create a room or join friends with a room code.
multiplayerNotReady: Online rooms are not connected yet. This feature will be added in a later version.
howToStepOneBody: Every card has a shape, a shape color, and a background color.
howToStepTwoTitle: Find a set of three cards
howToStepTwoBody: For each attribute, the three cards must show either all the same value or three different values.
howToStepThreeTitle: Find every set, then call “No sets left!”
howToStepThreeBody: Each correct set earns 1 point. An incorrect set costs 1 point. Correctly clearing the board earns a 3-point bonus.
ruleExampleTitle: The rule applies separately to every attribute
ruleExampleBody: A valid trio can have the same shape, three different colors, and three different backgrounds. All three attributes must independently follow the rule.
footerNote: A fresh, independent implementation of a classic three-attribute matching challenge.
boardInstruction: Call “Find a set!” before choosing three cards.
feedbackWrong: That is not a set. −1 point.
feedbackDuplicate: That set was already found. Your score has not changed.
feedbackSelectFirst: Select “Find a set!” before choosing cards.
roundCompleteBody: You found every set on this board.
confirmQuit: Leave this game and return home? Your current session will end.
metaDescription: An English-first combination card game with English and Korean language support.
